newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dana says first oil flows from Sortymskoye.
newsitem.headline: Dana says first oil flows from Sortymskoye.

text.p: Irish-based exploration firm Dana Petroleum said on Wednesday that first oil had been produced from its Sortymskoye field ahead of schedule.
Sortymskoye is the second field Dana has brought into production in West Siberia.
Dana said initial natural flow rates had exceeded predictions.

"During the early testing period it is planned to have the wells choked back whilst optimising the production facilities tie-in to the adjacent field. Even under this heavy restriction, the wells are combining to produce some 650 barrels per day," Dana said in a statement.
"Current high well pressures indicate that flow rates will increase substantially as the wells are opened up and eventually have pumps installed," it said.
Dana Petroleum and Russian oil company YUKOS each hold a 30 percent share in Sortymskoye, with the remaining 40 percent held by three other companies, Dana said.
